What does Pixelbrahma offer?

Pixelbrahma is a design and technology studio that offers website design, mobile app development, digital marketing and branding, from offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton (Canada).

Our services

Web design, app development, digital marketing and branding under one roof. Choose one service, or let us join them up so your product, your marketing and your brand pull in the same direction.

App Development

iOS, Android and web apps

Cross-platform mobile apps for iOS, Android and the web, designed around real users and built to keep their data safe.

From the first wireframe to the App Store and Google Play release, our teams in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton design, develop and secure apps that feel native on every screen.

→

Website Design & Development

Custom, fast, search-ready sites

Custom websites that load fast, read clearly and give search engines and AI assistants exactly what they need.

Business websites, landing pages and online stores built with clean code, advanced security and SEO-ready structure, so visitors understand you quickly and search engines can index every page.

→

Digital Marketing

Social media and content

Social media management, content creation and campaigns that bring the right customers to your brand.

We plan, publish and optimise social media content and campaigns so your brand reaches the right audience, keeps its audience engaged and grows steadily.

How every Pixelbrahma project runs

A simple path from first conversation to a product that keeps improving.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We learn your audience, goals and constraints.

    • Goals and audience call
    • Competitor and channel review
    • Scope, plan and timeline
  2. 02

    Design

    We shape the idea, the experience and the visual system.

    • Wireframes and prototypes
    • Visual direction and identity
    • Review and refine with you
  3. 03

    Build and launch

    We develop, test and release with care.

    • Development sprints and production
    • Testing and security checks
    • Launch and handover
  4. 04

    Grow

    We measure, learn and keep improving.

    • Analytics and monthly reporting
    • Content and campaign updates
    • Ongoing improvements

Pixelbrahma services FAQs

Which services we offer, where we work and how projects start.

Ask us directly
Which services does Pixelbrahma offer?

We offer website design and development, mobile app development, digital marketing (social media management and content creation) and branding (logo, brochures, leaflets, magazines, packaging, in-shop branding, outdoor and TV commercials).

Can I hire you for just one service?

Yes. Many clients start with a single project, such as a logo or a website, and add other services later.

Do you offer web design and app development in Bengaluru and Kochi?

Yes. Our Kasturinagar studio in Bengaluru and our Kadavanthara team in Kochi design and build websites and apps for local and national clients.

Do you work with businesses in Canada?

Yes. Our Brampton office supports businesses in the Greater Toronto Area and across Canada.

How do I choose where to start?

Tell us your goal on a short call. We usually suggest starting with the service that removes your biggest blocker, whether that is a clear brand, a website or steady marketing.

Tell us which service you need

Tell us what you are working on. We will reply with questions and a suggested next step.
